verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line saying Zia can create reports in seconds. That shows Zoho CRM has native reporting, but nothing describes how deep it goes or whether it covers pipeline, activity or conversion. The developer-side function-monitoring dashboard and COQL/API data access are adjacent building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented native dashboards, pipeline/activity/conversion report types, report builder details (filters, charts, scheduling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
